Constant velocity: an analysis example

Compare the spacing of the object images with a position–time graph.

Try this sample →

1. Create a photo

Open the sample below, choose a time range and interval, and create a photo. Check that successive images are spaced approximately equally.

2. Plot x–t

Mark the same point on the object and select Detect all frames. Align the x-axis with the direction of motion, then select x–t from Graphs.

3. Calculate velocity

Choose a linear fit. In x(t) = a + bt, the slope b is velocity along the x-axis. The unit is m/s after length calibration, or px/s without it.
